name: Anesaki Nozomi
source:
Being the idol of the school and vice president of the student council, Nozomi uses a lot of time and effort to appear as admirable and likable to other people. She is very particular about the way she wants herself seen by others. Nozomi is straightforward and able to stand up to herself and to others when needed, without being needlessly cold either.

[From [url=http://maidenkingdom.wordpress.com/2014/06/22/otoge-review-watashi-no-real-wa-juujitsu-shisugiteiru/]Maiden Kingdom[/url]]
